# CI/CD Badges

Add these badges to your main README.md:

```markdown
[![Backend Test](https://github.com/yaken-org/hakushi/actions/workflows/backend-test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/yaken-org/hakushi/actions/workflows/backend-test.yml)
[![Go Report Card](https://goreportcard.com/badge/github.com/yaken-org/hakushi)](https://goreportcard.com/report/github.com/yaken-org/hakushi)
```

## Setup Instructions

1. Enable GitHub Actions in your repository settings
2. The workflow will run automatically on push/PR
